safe_test_strategy: Compare designated test-session validity against its documented expiry and logout policy.
expected_behavior: Expired or invalidated sessions must not access protected resources.

potential_false_positives.scenario: Public, cached, reflected or synthetic content resembles a protected result.
potential_false_positives.mitigation: Verify the resource policy, distinct identities, provenance and negative controls before confirming.

confirmation_criteria: Protected read succeeds with a session proven invalid under the applicable policy.
